blocks.text: The Cloud Lures module allows you to set up lures for Microsoft Azure decoys, Amazon Web Services (AWS) decoys, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) decoys on endpoints. You can set up lures for the following decoys:

blocks.item: AWS IAM: Used to place the credentials of selected decoy AWS IAM users on endpoints. When this option is enabled, a hidden folder with the name .aws is created under C:\Users\<username>\ on Windows endpoints and under /users/<username>/on Linux endpoints to store the credentials.
Azure File Shares: Used to mount selected file share decoys on endpoints. When this option is enabled, the decoy file share is mounted as a network drive on the endpoints.

Azure Service Principals: Used to place the secrets of selected service principal decoys on endpoints. When this option is enabled, a hidden folder with the name .azure is created under C:\Users\<username>\ on Windows endpoints to store secrets.
Service principal decoys are not supported on Linux endpoints.

Azure Users: Used to place the credentials of selected decoy Azure users on endpoints. When this option is enabled, a hidden folder with the name .azure is created under C:\Users\<username>\ on Windows endpoints to store secrets.
Azure user decoys are not supported on Linux endpoints.
Azure Storage Explorer: Used to enable access to storage account container decoys via the Azure Storage Explorer app from endpoints.
GCP Service Account: Used to access other GCP decoys.

blocks.text: You must configure the supported AWS and Azure decoys before setting up the cloud lures.
To configure cloud lures via a landmine policy:

blocks.item: Locate the policy, and click the Edit icon.
In the policy configuration window, click Cloud Lures.
Select the cloud service provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP), locate the cloud decoys that you want to configure, and for each decoy:
Enabled: Select to enable the decoy.
Target decoys: Select one or more decoys from the drop-down menu to use as a cloud lure.
The GenAI icon indicates lures that support generative AI decoys as target decoys.
